pages.text: $(l)Large engines$()$(li)$(item)Needs a Powered Shaft 2 blocks in front$(): right-click the engine with a shaft to place it at the right spot, crossing the engine's direction.$(li)$(item)Needs Air in its air tank$(): pipe air from an Air Intake.

$(li)$(item)No fuel$(): pipe fuel in.$(li)$(item)Unsupported fuel: use diesel, kerosene, naphtha or furnace gas$(): drain the tank, then refill with one of those.$(li)$(item)Exhaust full: pump the CO2 away$().$(br2)$(l)Small engines$()

$(li)$(item)Engine Unfinished$() with $(item)Next Component$(): keep right-clicking parts in, one full set per block.$(li)$(item)Pistons Missing$() / $(item)Turbines Missing$(): add cylinders or turbine blades.

$(li)Gold line $(item)No output shaft$(): right-click an end block with a shaft (regular engines only; radial and turbine engines have theirs built in).$(li)$(item)Signal: 0$(): no redstone, so no rotation. Power any block of the engine, or link an engine controller.
A small engine also stops, without a line of its own, when its exhaust tank is full or its fuel is not one its cylinders accept.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
